required_clauses.title: Confidentiality Obligation
required_clauses.description: Requires the Receiving Party to protect and not disclose Confidential Information except as permitted, and to use it only for the stated purpose.

required_clauses.title: Term and Survival
required_clauses.description: Defines the agreement duration and which confidentiality obligations survive termination. Standard NDA term is 2-5 years.

required_clauses.title: Governing Law
required_clauses.description: Specifies which state law governs the agreement and jurisdiction for disputes.

required_clauses.title: Return or Destruction of Materials
required_clauses.description: Requires prompt return or destruction of Confidential Information upon request or termination, often including written certification.

required_clauses.title: Exclusions from Confidentiality
required_clauses.description: Carves out information that is publicly available, already known to recipient, independently developed, or disclosed by a third party without restriction.

required_clauses.title: Permitted Disclosures
required_clauses.description: Defines who within the receiving party may access confidential information (e.g., employees, advisors, legal counsel) and under what conditions.

required_clauses.title: No License or Rights Granted
required_clauses.description: Clarifies that disclosure of confidential information does not grant any license, title, or intellectual property rights to the receiving party.

required_clauses.title: Remedies for Breach
required_clauses.description: States that breach may cause irreparable harm entitling the disclosing party to seek injunctive relief without posting bond, in addition to other remedies.

required_clauses.title: Dispute Resolution
required_clauses.description: Defines how disputes will be resolved — negotiation, mediation, or arbitration — and which courts have jurisdiction.

required_clauses.title: Return or Destruction
required_clauses.description: Requires return or destruction of confidential information when the agreement ends.

optional_clauses.title: Non-Solicitation
optional_clauses.description: Prevents parties from soliciting each other's employees during the NDA term.

optional_clauses.title: Entire Agreement
optional_clauses.description: States this agreement supersedes all prior discussions and constitutes the entire agreement between the parties.
